summary: Fully clickable promotional banner: the whole surface is a single <a href> (navigation) or <button> (action), with icon, title, description, chevron and an optional dismiss button.
whenToUse: Promoting a feature, plan upgrade, event or content in a dashboard.
Highly visible shortcut to a single destination or action.
whenNotToUse: System messages or errors: use Banner or Alert.
Content with multiple inner links or controls: use Card with CardLink or HeroCard with actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Main text; part of the accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text; also part of the accessible name, so keep it short.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination: the surface is an <a href>. Alternative to onPress.

props.name: linkProps
props.description: React Aria Link props (target, rel, routerOptions, onPress…), only with href.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Action: the surface is a <button>. Alternative to href.

props.name: tone
props.description: Surface; brand and accent use the expressive gradients.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a separate dismiss button (sibling, not nested). You persist the dismissal.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

inherits: HTML attributes of <div> on the container (id, style, data-*, aria-*); the ref points to the container.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the surface and then to the dismiss button.
Follows the link (or activates the button).
Activates the surface when it is a <button>.

accessibility: A single native interactive element for the surface: no clickable div, no nested interactive elements.
The dismiss button is a sibling of the surface, with a localized name (messages.dismiss).
Icon and chevron are decorative (aria-hidden); the chevron is mirrored in RTL.
brand/accent use action-primary-foreground on a gradient; success/warning use text-primary on feedback surfaces.
Clickable area at least 56px tall; focus ring visible in forced-colors mode too.
responsive: Full container width; text wraps while icon and chevron stay aligned.
commonMistakes: Using onPress to navigate: pass href so that open in new tab and copy link work.
Long descriptions: they end up entirely in the link's accessible name.
Forgetting to persist the dismissal: onDismiss does not hide the banner on its own.

examples.name: Dismissible
examples.title: Dismissible
examples.description: Visibility is the consumer's local state.

limits: The dismiss button is positioned over the surface: its area does not activate the link (reserved padding).
For links that open a new tab, add the textual hint to the description yourself.
